modalLead: Five more media widgets next to Jellyfin: Sonarr and Radarr, Seerr, and the download clients qBittorrent and SABnzbd. And adding a widget now starts with a search.

items.text: See what is coming in Sonarr and Radarr, with the posters: the episodes and films of the next days, and what is downloading. Pick a list, a strip with Upcoming and Queue as tabs, a grid, or the next one large.
items.title: What's coming in Sonarr and Radarr

media.alt: The Sonarr widget on the dashboard: the episodes coming up, each under its series poster

items.text: Follow your downloads in qBittorrent and SABnzbd: progress, speed and time left, with the client's speeds on top. One list, or a tab each for Downloading, Paused and Done.
items.title: Your downloads, with progress and speed

items.text: See your requests in Seerr (Overseerr or Jellyseerr): what waits for approval, what is on its way and what has arrived, with the poster and who asked.
items.title: Requests in Seerr, and who asked

media.alt: The Seerr widget: requests with their posters, who asked and whether they arrived

items.text: Add a widget starts with a search. Type what you are after, choose with the arrow keys and press Enter; the one you are on is shown beside the list. New kinds carry a New badge, and the Catalogue gathers them at the top.
A few labels showed in English in the other languages: the widget search, the New badge, and messages in the Inbox and after a re-check.
